effect.complicated_bees.magicbees:drunka: Makes creatures in the territory dizzy.
Lets creatures in the territory dig faster.
effect.complicated_bees.magicbees:invisi: Turns creatures in the territory invisible.
effect.complicated_bees.magicbees:node_e: Slowly grows a nearby aura node.
effect.complicated_bees.magicbees:node_p: Turns a nearby aura node pure.
effect.complicated_bees.magicbees:node_r: Turns a nearby aura node hungry.
Steadies and brightens a nearby aura node.
effect.complicated_bees.magicbees:node_t: Turns a nearby aura node tainted.
effect.complicated_bees.magicbees:spawn_: Summons brainy zombies (plain zombies without Thaumaturge).
Summons a ghast now and then.
Summons mana creepers and mana vortexes.
Summons wisps, or vexes without Thaumaturge.
effect.complicated_bees.magicbees:swiftn: Speeds up creatures in the territory.
effect.complicated_bees.magicbees:transm: Hardens sand into sandstone in sandy biomes.
gui.magicbees.mutations.near_node: Requires an aura node within %s blocks
jei.magicbees.info.apimancers_drainer: Place it under a housing with an Essentia queen and attune it with a phial or jar of an aspect. It fills with up to 512 essentia, ages the queen faster, and offers the essentia to tubes.
jei.magicbees.info.aromatic_lump: Crafted from pollen, royal jelly, an Enchanting Drop and honey. With Thaumaturge, a crucible turns it into Unusual Pollen. With Aromara, four lumps and string make a Redolent Bundle: its brazier vapour keeps people fed, its oil makes attackers miss.
jei.magicbees.info.bee_ring: Use the ring with drones in your off hand to load it; sneak-use with an empty off hand to take them back. Worn in a Curios ring slot (or carried, without Curios), the working drone's effect runs around you until it dies, then the next drone starts.
jei.magicbees.info.blood_frame: A frame for bee housings; its tooltip lists what it changes. Every point of wear is mended with 1000 LP from the housing owner's soul network (Neo Vitae).
jei.magicbees.info.blood_soaked_frame: A frame for bee housings; its tooltip lists what it changes. Every point of wear is mended with 1000 LP from the housing owner's soul network (Neo Vitae).
jei.magicbees.info.effect_jar: Right-click with drones to load the jar. One drone at a time runs its species effect around the jar, as if it were a hive, and ages until it dies; the next waiting drone then takes over. Right-click with an empty hand to take the waiting drones back or see the active bee's life.
jei.magicbees.info.enchanted_earth: Counts as soil for any plant. Its random ticks hurry along the growing block above it and one next to it.
jei.magicbees.info.frenzied_frame: A frame for bee housings; its tooltip lists what it changes. Every point of wear is mended with 1000 LP from the housing owner's soul network (Neo Vitae).
jei.magicbees.info.magianaturalis.mutati: Put it in an item frame on a bee housing: the queen's offspring mutate more often.
jei.magicbees.info.moon_dial: Shows the current moon phase. Some Magic Bees mutations only happen in a certain phase.
jei.magicbees.info.mysterious_magnet: Right-click to switch it on or off. While on, it pulls nearby items to you; the range grows with its level (3 + 0.75 per level; craft it again to level it up), and from level 7 it also picks up stuck arrows. Works from a Curios necklace slot too.
jei.magicbees.info.technomancy.crop_acce: Placed against a bee housing, it speeds up the bees inside (more produce) while it has power. Each work cycle of the bees costs it a little existence.
jei.magicbees.info.vis_aura_provider: Place it touching a bee housing. It draws vis from the chunk's aura into 10 charges and spends them to boost the housing. Right-click to cycle the boost: all, mutation x2, lifespan x0.5 or production x1.4.
message.magicbees.apimancers_drainer.una: Not attuned: tap it with a phial or jar of essentia
message.magicbees.vis_aura_provider.all: Boosting mutation, lifespan and production (%s/%s charges)
research.magicbees.apimancers_drainer.st: How long will your queen last?

The Apimancer's Drainer draws essentia from the life force of bees. Place it beneath an apiary or beehouse holding an Essentia queen, then tap it with a phial or jar of the essentia you want. Every ten seconds it fills with that essentia, more with better production, and the queen ages faster for it. Tubes can pull from any side.
research.magicbees.blood_frame.stage_0: Welcome, honored guest. To the birthplace of our Dynasty!
research.magicbees.blood_frame.stage_1:
You feel a shiver pulse through your very soul as you hold this frame. You feel... horrified.

You aren't quite sure what you created while you were entranced in a blood-enraged frenzy, but you can only watch in abject terror as your bees slowly crumble before your very eyes, only to be replaced in a flash by grotesque simulacrum.

You almost swear you can see it... beating? As if somehow it were alive?

But... surely not, that would be madness after all...
research.magicbees.blood_frame.title: Sanguis Artus
research.magicbees.dimensional_singulari: Quantum flux for them, unlimited storage for you

While it may appear similar to the Portable Hole, it serves as a two-way link with another place, which is... probably uninhabited. It should be possible to utilize these singularities to store materials outside of your dimensional understanding - which of course means that they won't clutter up your inventory. As they are now, they are not particularly useful, but there should be ways to unlock their potential.
research.magicbees.essence_armor.stage_1:
This is the distilled essence of protection, bound to last forever, or until the magics stored within it weaken and eventually break. But until then, it's invincible. Mostly. 

 While Magic Frames are useful, they are a tad fragile. This essence takes the enchantments you weave into Magic frames to an entirely new level. Combine the essence with a magic frame, and it should have a vastly extended lifespan.
research.magicbees.essence_armor.title: Essence of Everlasting Durability
research.magicbees.essence_death.stage_1:
The Essence of a Shallow Grave channels the death of many of the ... "natural" creatures that wander the world: Zombies, Skeletons, those sorts of things. Exposing bees to this energy has the effect of making them slow and sluggish, and curtails the extent of their lifespan. Some Apimancers consider using frames imbued with these Essences to be cruel, however, others view it as a natrual part of normal beekeeping, with an eye to creating their perfect strain of bees sometime within THEIR lifetime. 

 The Apimancer's Guild of Safety recommends handling them with telekenisis or very long tongs.
research.magicbees.essence_death.title: Essence of a Shallow Grave
research.magicbees.essence_life.stage_0: A rose by any other name. . .
research.magicbees.essence_life.stage_1: Simple to create by means of magic, this essence has unusual properties when exposed to bees. When combined with an everyday apiary frame, it has the effect of greatly extending the lifespan of a working hive.
research.magicbees.essence_life.title: Essence of False Life
research.magicbees.essence_oblivion.stag:
Breeding bees for mutations can be aggrivating, especially whith long-lived species. With a little cleverness and only the slightest hint of smugness, you have found a way to utilize the Dimensional Singularity in a manner that only sucks away the life force of your tiny flying friends, bit by bit. Well, maybe significant amounts all at once. It's probably not going to affect them too badly. 

 It may be somewhat tricky to obtain more than one of the §5Dragon Eggs§0 nessecary to obtain more than one of these. Perhaps there is a bee species that can assist with the limitation.
research.magicbees.essence_time.stage_1:
Time is a fickle thing. It comes and it goes, but where exactly does it go to? As a respectable thaumaturge, it has become possible to trap these wasted moments and save them in a magical form. So, now that it is possible to collect extra time from the world, it seems only appropriate that they are used in a place that would be useful. It would be too dangerous to attempt to access these moments yourself for the moment, but perhaps it would be simple to allow your bees access to this untapped lump of time. 

 By combining the essence with a Magic Frame as usual will suffice to extend the lifespan of bees in your keeping by several times.
research.magicbees.essence_time.title: Essence of Lost Time
research.magicbees.essence_unstable.stag: Unstable by nature, the Essence of Fickle Permanence has the side effect of causing normally stable objects and systems to become somewhat unreliable. While this may mostly be a bad thing, Apimancers have discovered that exposing a hive to the essence has the duel effects of both causing the bees to work faster, and the offspring to have higher mutation rates.
research.magicbees.frame_magic.stage_1: The Magic Frame is a simple improvement over your regular, run-of-the-mill Untreated Frames. Still fairly simple to produce, it is capable of lasting three times longer in an apiary than Untreated Frames before becoming unuseable. The enchantable properties of the Magic Frame enable it to be used with several of the special essences involved in Apimancy where other frames would reject the infusion of magics.
research.magicbees.frame_magic.title: Magic Frame
research.magicbees.frenzied_frame.stage_: May chaos take the world! May chaos take the world!

You don't know how it came to you... madness, is it not?

You remember yourself swearing to others that you heard some kind of voice in the back of your mind, almost silently... screaming? You can vaguely remember its ghastly call, screaming for you to burn the world in the purifying flames of chaos.

You took it into your hands, and you distinctly remember feeling the chaotic energies burning through your body, singeing your very mind in its fire.



But... surely you didn't, that would be madness after all...
research.magicbees.frenzied_frame.title: Maddening Frame of Frenzy
research.magicbees.lore_fragment.stage_1: Scholarly and Savant bees sometimes bring back Lore Fragments. Four of them bound together make a Curio of Knowledge.
research.magicbees.lore_fragment.title: Lore Fragments
research.magicbees.root.stage_0: Adding some sparkle to your buzz.
research.magicbees.root.stage_1:
Welcome to Apimancy! As a budding keeper of magical bees, there are a few things you should know before diving in. As your acceptance letter to the Academy of Austere Apimancers has mentioned, there are several new tools available to discover. These include some improved versions of Forestry tools, each with their own particular quirks and new frames for your apiaries. 

The magical strains begin with the wild Mystical, Sorcerous, Unusual and Attuned bees, whose nests turn up in forests, plains, deserts and mountains. Breed them with ordinary bees and with each other to find the rest.
research.magicbees.root.title: Apimancy
research.magicbees.scoop.stage_1:
Normal scoops are fragile, and prone to breakage. As an authority in Apimancy, you can do better. By adding some Thaumium to the handle, and lacing it with a measure of order, your new scoop will last up to three times longer! 

 In addition, the Thaumium in the device will accept the Repair enchantment.
research.magicbees.scoop.title: Thaumium Scoop
research.magicbees.scoop_void.stage_1:
Void metal is a curious thing, and it's time to see what it can bring to Apimancy. Its self-regenerative properties have seeped their way into the net as well, creating a most unsettling mesh.

Hopefully it won't affect the bees too much...
research.magicbees.scoop_void.title: Void Scoop
research.magicbees.vis_aura_provider.sta:
Infusing Unusual Pollen with vis and binding it in gold and greatwood makes a crystal that draws vis from the aura and charges itself. Set it against any apiary or beehouse and the bees inside feel it.

Right-click to choose the boost: all three at once, a doubled mutation rate, a halved lifespan, or a production boost. Each charge lasts a while; the all-in-one boost costs the same charge as a single one, but runs out sooner.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:aband: "The more I study these bees, the more I feel they do not belong here, or anywhere else."
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:adami: It does not bend, and it does not forgive.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:aeria: It has never seen the ground and sees no reason to.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:afrit: Bound in fire, it guards its honey as it would a hoard.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:alche: Salt, sulfur and mercury, in that order.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:alfhe: It came through the portal and kept the elves' manners.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ambro: Its honey glows faintly, and so do the people who eat it.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:apati: Day and night the whining droned on. I barricaded the windows and hid in the cellar, but everywhere the high-pitched noise of the apatine bees penetrated the walls and drove me to distraction.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:arcan: It nests in obelisks if you let it.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ardit: Fond of yellowish-orange material found in hellish areas.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ars_a: Swift as the wind, and lighter than air.
"Curious creatures, though their produce is quite useful."
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ars_e: Empowered by the Earth, their produce is infused with its essence.
Drawing from motes of dust in the air and ground, they concentrate the energy
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ars_f: Their colony can reach temperatures that boil water and melt metals.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ars_i: "They keep stealing stuff from me, and I never see them. They're far too slippery."
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ars_l: They can travel vast distances in a blink, and are known for starting many wildfires.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ars_p: They have an affinity for all that is green and grows.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ars_q: The heart of magic lies dormant in all things.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ars_v: Ravenous for mana, they may be dangerous for any caster.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ars_w: Through prolonged exposure to liquids, their combs are quite wet and heavy.
"They attract magical spirits; not always docile."
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:astra: Starlight gathered where there are no stars.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:attun: They fly as though guided by unseen threads through the air.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:aurel: It only dances when the moon is full.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:auror: It dances in the cold sky, and so does its honey.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:avari: It keeps a little of every haul for itself.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:batty: They tend to attract bats to their hives through means unknown.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:big_b: "Who is afraid of the Big Bad Chris?"
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:bismu: Its cells grow in little stairs.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:bligh: Where it lands, the grass turns grey and soft.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:botan: It knows every flower by its colour.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:brain: Their combs may be fetid and foul-smelling, but their intelligence is well-developed.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:bronz: "I love these bees so much, I had them preserved for later."
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:carmi: Its hum has the same pitch as a tower ghast's sob.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:certu: The OTHER kind of Quartz, slightly bluer, but no less valuable.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:chaos: The social structure of their hives seems to vary day by day, making it more flexible and resillient than others, but significantly more unpredictable.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:chaot: Each generation is a different colour from the last.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:charm: Your first experiments in Thaumaturgical Apiculture have yielded fruit. Buzzing fruit.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:cobal: The unstable properties of this material seem to not affect the bees in the slightest.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:coppe: A base metal common in many applications; these bees are helpful for resource-starved magicians.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:corru: The crystal it touches goes dark.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:coven: Thirteen to a hive, and never one more.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:crims: It wears the cult's colours and none of its doubts.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:crumb: They have a corrosive effect on their surroundings, rapidly aging them.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:deoru: Gold fit for the gods, one flake at a time.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:diabo: It signs every contract in its own wax.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:diamo: Crystalline, glittering, and harder than dragon's teeth. These bees are none of those.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:dimen: It forages on both sides of the portal.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:djinn: It keeps its bargains to the letter, and only to the letter.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:docto: Passing stranger with a great scarf and a blue box
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:draco: "With a fel sound, they erupted from their hive. That was the last we ever saw of Gerald."
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:dream: It flies the paths it dreamed.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:druid: It hums the old names of every tree it passes.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:earth: "You're really gonna dig these bees, but watch out - they bore quite easily."
They have an iron-strong connection with stone and dirt.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:eldri: The potential that was locked within this bee's ancestors has now come to the fore.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:elect: The best of both precious metals, but somehow greater than both.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:emera: It is said they have been to a land ruled by a Great Wizard, and have taken the aspect of his city.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:empow: So charged with aura are they, that nodes seem to wax in their presence.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:encha: Successive generations of Charmed bees have reinforced their connection to the unknown.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:endli: A northern light that wandered too far.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:esote: An unusual crossbreed which seems to have magical properties.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:essen: "Why spam Essentia Condensers when you can just use bees?"
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ether: Ghostly, and charged with energy from beyond.
Where a node died, it hums the tune back.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:fiery: Bred from a forest's grudge against the sky.
Caution: Contents of hive extremely hot.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:firey: As close as you can get to living flame without involving candescence.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:flesh: Nobody asks what it was before.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:fluix: Fusing properties of Redstone, Nether Quartz and Certus Quartz, the Fluix crystal itself is unusual, unstable, and volatile if struck with TNT.
"I thought they would help clean up, but it only makes things worse!"
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:folio: The lowest of the spirits answers to a hive as readily as to a pentacle.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:forgo: It remembers a city no one else does.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:forlo: "I am now convinced they were left in our universe on purpose by some unknowable beings."
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:fract: Reality is thinner around the hive.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:frost: The hive is always colder than the room.
Its wings frost over in flight.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:gemcu: It cuts facets into its own wax.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:gloom: Born where the sun has never been.
Not all that glitters is gold.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:gravi: Its combs drift upward if you don't weigh them down.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:hallo: Its wings smell faintly of rain on a shrine.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:hatef: Continued exposure to the Nether has not improved their temperament in the least. Use caution.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:haunt: You hear the hive before you see it, and you never quite see it.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:hedge: It knows which root screams before you pull it.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:hungr: It is unknown how the bees take raw essence from the nodes and what they do with it, but the process eventually transforms the node into a terrifying vortex.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ichor: The blood of the gods, one drop a season.
Its honey moves when no one is looking.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:iesni: It gathers a metal no one can see without spirit sight.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:imper: It expects the other hives to bow.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:infer: The first step on a long ladder.
Spawned deep within the hellish realm, none have survived long enough to determine their abilities.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:invar: "The coefficient of thermal expansion is quite low. Also, it's a pun!"
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:invis: Easy to miss, their glassy body is difficult to spot in the countryside.
Having absorbed some of the base metal, these bees can concentrate the essence of iron from the region.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:ironw: Half bark, half ore, all stubbornness.
A favourite of amateur alchemists, they believe they can transform these bees into gold.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:lordl: They live in peace, within the sight of the Eye of Harmony
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:lunat: The priests of the moon kept hives. This is why.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:marid: The greatest of the bound spirits stoops to tend a comb only when it is amused.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:midni: It only visits flowers that open after dark.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mithm: The last alloy anyone bothered to name.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mithr: Light as a feather, hard as a promise.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mtl_a: Strange metal that bends the light.
The rarest gleam in the world's crust.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mtl_c: The alchemists' metal, gathered drop by drop.
Cold metal from a hot place.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mtl_d: It nests where the ore runs deepest.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mtl_i: Warm to the touch, even in winter.
Darkened metal that drinks the light.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mtl_l: Pale as the ghosts it is named for.
A rare earth for a rare bee.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mtl_m: A black metal from beyond the edge.
Everything it touches turns a little brighter.
Light as a feather, harder than its hive.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mtl_o: The lost metal of a drowned city.
Dense enough to sink through its own wax.
Its workers never seem to tire.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mtl_s: It feeds on more than nectar.
Forged in the dark between lava falls.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mtl_v: Born in the forge of the world.
Its sting carries a slow poison.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mtl_z: Pale and brittle, it galvanises the hive.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mutab: Changeable in nature, mercurial in personality.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:myste: These bees have been to the end of the world and back, and their power has grown.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:mysti: Common in many parts of the world, these bees have a little extra whimsy about them.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:namel: "Other naturalists have refused to study these bees. I must know why."
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:nexus: Spoken only of in hushed whispers, their abilities to pass through nodes into the other side is scoffed at as imagined and fantasy.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:nicke: "If I had a Nickel every time I've heard that... I'd have a hive!"
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:obliv: It is unclear whether these bees are native to this world, or some other.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:order: Their combs are nearly perfect, each part mirroring the pattern of the whole.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:pixie: It steals your honey and leaves glitter behind.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:pupil: "What does that bee want with my paper?!"
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:pyre_: Its sting is small. Its temper is not.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:regal: It holds court in the deepest caverns.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:rejuv: The hum of the hive is magical, and over time is absorbed by nearby nodes.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:riftb: It comes back from places that are not on the map.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:roote: It grows its comb into the wood.
Its cells glow red when the sun is low.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:salin: It leaves a crust on everything.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:savan: lim(x^(i / pi)/ log(e * 7 - ln(32/x^-pi))). Solve for honey.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:schol: "I can't be sure, but I think they might be smarter than me..."
It watches the beekeeper more closely than the beekeeper watches it.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:shado: It only works the frames that face away from the sun.
Light goes in. Nothing comes out.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:shimm: Its wings throw rainbows on the snow.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:silic: "Not to be confused with Silicone bees, AKA the Boo Bees!"
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:silve: While they do not recieve as much attention as Golden bees, they are nonetheless valuable.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:sinfu: Every vice has a cell, and every cell is full.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:siren: Its hum carries far over water.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:skulk: These bees have become xenophobic and bad-tempered. Use caution.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:skyst: Born of the union of the Earth and the Sky, falling to the ground, wreathed in flame.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:smoul: The Skulking bees have become alight with the fire of the ever-burning Blazes.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:sorce: Fond of warm, dry environments, they seem to have the ability to conjure water from thin air.
"The Dread Pirate Roberts has come for your SOOOOOOULS!"
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:soulb: Each bee carries a little more than its own life.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:spide: Spiderbee; n. Does whatever a spider-bee does.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:spiri: It is said these bees are able to contact the dead.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:spite: They guard their territory fiercely, with the zeal of fiends, and welts of fire.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:starl: It collects what falls from the stars.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:steel: It forages leaves that ring when struck.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:stell: It thrives in a heaven that went wrong.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:storm: You smell ozone before you hear the buzz.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:super: These bees walk the line between this world and the unseen.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:supre: There is nothing above it but the sky.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:terti: Third of its line, and it knows it.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:thaum: Thaumium that learned to hold a charge.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:timel: "An apiarist is never late. He arrives precisely when he means to!"
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:tin.f: While metalic, these bees are suprisingly fragile.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:titan: It mines the bones of something enormous.
species.complicated_bees.magicbees:trans: "I could've sworn this was made out of stone yesterday!"
